title: Boss: the slow transfer
summary: A transfer between datacentres crawls. Find out why from the numbers.

steps.title: The ticket
body: "Copying backups from Dublin to Singapore is slow and sometimes hangs." You have a packet capture summary, the link figures and the path MTUs.

steps.title: Spot retransmissions
prompt: Write `List<int> Retransmits(List<(int Seq, int Len)> sent)` returning, in order and without duplicates, every sequence number that was sent **again** after first being sent.
starter: List<int> Retransmits(List<(int Seq, int Len)> sent)
solution: List<int> Retransmits(List<(int Seq, int Len)> sent)
template: Dojo.Eq("clean", new List<int>(), Retransmits(new List<(int Seq, int Len)> { (1, 10), (11, 10) }));
hints: `HashSet.Add` returns false when it's already there.

steps.title: Window math
prompt: Write `double ThroughputMbps(long windowBytes, int rttMs)` (window / RTT, in megabits per second, rounded to 1 decimal with `Math.Round`)
and `long WindowFor(int mbps, int rttMs)`, the bytes in flight needed to fill a link (the bandwidth-delay product).
solution: double ThroughputMbps(long windowBytes, int rttMs) => Math.Round(windowBytes * 8.0 / (rttMs / 1000.0) / 1_000_000, 1);
long WindowFor(int mbps, int rttMs) => (long)mbps * 1_000_000 / 8 * rttMs / 1000;
hints: Do the `long` multiplication before dividing to avoid truncation.

steps.title: Path MTU discovery
prompt: Write `List<int> PathMtu(List<int> linkMtus, int start)` simulating PMTUD with DF set: send a packet of `start` bytes; the first link whose MTU is smaller drops it
and reports its MTU, so the sender retries at that size. Return every size tried, in order; the last is the path MTU.
Then write `string Verdict(List<int> linkMtus, int start, bool icmpBlocked)`: `"ok, path MTU {n}"`, or, if any link is smaller than `start` and ICMP is blocked,
starter: string Verdict(List<int> linkMtus, int start, bool icmpBlocked)
solution: string Verdict(List<int> linkMtus, int start, bool icmpBlocked)
template: Dojo.Eq("black hole", "black hole at 1420", Verdict(dojoL, 1500, true));
Dojo.Eq("small packets fine even when blocked", "ok, path MTU 1300", Verdict(dojoL, 1300, true));
hints: Repeatedly find the first link smaller than the current size.
